On Wednesday, December 10th from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Sackville Trenching on behalf of Halifax Water will be undertaking street reinstatement work following the recent water main repair at the intersection of Jaybe Drive and Waverley Road, Dartmouth.

Local traffic only on Waverley Road between Breeze Drive and Lethbridge Avenue. A detour will be in place. Experienced traffic control personnel will be on-site to manage traffic flows.
